categories.name: tests
categories.evidence: Has the Tests label and modifies unit test code in src/test/sock_tests.cpp to fix socket stream read assumptions.
categories.rationale: Fixes latent test flakiness where `send_and_receive` assumed socket data always arrives in a single chunk. While partial reads are improbable on standard CI loopback, handling them aligns with TCP stream semantics and resolves an issue identified across the test suite (#36726).
